newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai B share index ends up with A shares.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai B share index ends up with A shares.

text.p: Shanghai's B share index ended up sharply on Wednesday following Tuesday's breach of resistance levels around 68-69 points in line with the domestic A shares, brokers said.
The B index rose 1.314 points or 1.87 percent to 71.619 points on volume of 34.8 million shares worth $15.6 million, up from Tuesday's $11 million.
The A share index ended at 1,177.703 points, up 17.058 points or 1.47 percent after 892 million shares worth 9.7 billion yuan traded. Tuesday's turnover was 8.7 billion yuan.

Brokers said follow-up buying emerged after the B index rose above the 68 to 69-point resistance level on Tuesday. The strong performance of A shares also boosted domestic investors' confidence, they said.
"Domestic investors bought B shares actively, which pushed the index up," one broker said.
"The index is likely to rise further in the short term, but the potential is limited because most firms' 1996 results are expected to be poor," one broker said.
"The speculative mood supported rises on the A market, which may trigger a second crackdown by Beijing," he added.
All 43 B shares traded, with 31 up, six flat and six down.
Shanghai Vacuum & Electron Device Co was the star on speculative domestic buying triggered by talk of an upcoming financial reconstructure, brokers said.
It soared $0.02 or 9.52 percent to $0.23 on volume of 1.3 million shares.
Textile company Shanghai Worldbest Co traded the most on expectations of good 1996 results, rising $0.014 or 2.8 percent to $0.514 on volume of 2.9 million shares.
Shanghai's A share index rose on the bullish market mood with a surge of fresh capital, but the market needs a technical correction in short term, brokers said.
The SSE 30 blue-chip index gained 51.374 points or 1.73 percent to 3023.647 points.
Shanghai Vacuum & Electron Device Co became the star in line with its B shares counterpart, surging 0.61 yuan to its 10 percent limit-up of 6.67 yuan on volume of 15.4 million shares.
